'''October 2001 Normal tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Normal, Illinois in October 2001. [[Matt Hempstead]] won it. It is known from Bradley Augsburger's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3044">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-normal-illinois-the-saga-continuesd3044/ normal-illinois-the-saga-continues], DeckTech (Bradley "BadBrad" Augsburger, 10 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-10-normal-illinois-the-saga-continuesd3044/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 2001
* '''Site:''' Normal, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Hempstead]]
